html:
Question 11
?

Construction waste stored in a large pile is taken to a landfill. The height H of the pile decreases with time. The rate of change of the pile's height is proportional to the square of the height. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the height at time t?

a
dHdt=kH2,k>0
b
dHdt=−kH,k>0
c
dHdt=kH2,k>0
d
dHdt=−kH,k>0
e
dHdt=−kH2,k>0
Submit
